method: The fix report's Rounds 1-4 and critics 92j, 92l, 92n; the statechart row map rebuilt against the fixed source and checked by 87/row_map_check.py (99 anchors, 3 of 3 wordings); the tool notes derived by 83/record_formal.py's formula; every cited file:line checked by 92/cite_check.py

subject: ours:statechart
why: Bug cr-r2pa.2.28.8 (scratchpad/mvp-stack/92/fix/report.md, Rounds 1-4). The tool crashed with an IndexError (statechart_lib/tlc.py judge) when TLC, in a drawing run with -continue, reported a broken invariant and then failed while printing its path; such a break is now named and counted, no state invented, and the report keeps the rule's heading, says no path is drawn and which .out file holds TLC's output, and notes the unprinted count. Three reporting defects fixed with it: a stopped drawing run's marks are now partial per rule, with the legend giving marked, printed and not-in-graph counts and mayBreak meaning the others are unknown, while the retained graph's own completeness is tracked apart, so a whole graph keeps its deadlock marks; the summary's first line names the run the graph comes from and its own counts, apart from what failing paths add, when the graph or a rule's marks are incomplete, and the drawing-budget line no longer says every rule was checked when some are listed as not checked; the after-a-failure note appears only when a drawn arrow leaves a breaking state. references/report.md says the same. No trait is added, removed or reworded; the tree hash is refreshed in traits/ours.yaml and the 30 tool notes whose cited lines moved are rewritten from the rebuilt row map (scratchpad/mvp-stack/92/fix/maps/). Critics 92j and 92l (REVISE, fixed in rounds 3 and 4) and 92n (PASS); new real-TLC fixtures Untraced, UntracedStart, UntracedPartial, UntracedDeadlock, PathExtra and Hidden with tests in tests/checks/test_statechart_chart.py and test_statechart_tlc.py.
